next_small_prototype.demonstrated_source_fact: The whole-image entry validates immutable application channels and weight, then public apply_iso_gain_sample validates the same facts for every component.
next_small_prototype.hypothesis: A private validated kernel may avoid repeated validation work; compiler hoisting and actual savings are unknown. No optimization claim yet.
next_small_prototype.shape: Keep public scalar API validation; use one private boundary/kernel for already validated whole-image calls. Do not add a general framework.
must_preserve: Code-domain bilinear interpolation before nonlinear gain
Per-channel gamma/offsets, exact f64 operation order and final f32 result
Full-resolution HDR reconstruction before linear-light area reduction
Public invalid-input behavior and reconstructed nonfinite/f32 overflow rejection
All orientation, source-media, native Styles and Tone assertions
next_small_prototype.verification: Differential f32 bit/error comparisons across mono/RGB, padded strides, scale ratios, fractional interpolated codes, gamma/weight extremes, offsets and overflow; then one parent-approved same-host isolated native comparison with exact new source/binary receipts. Retain unchanged absolute gate and all failures.
next_small_prototype.stop_condition: Discard if compiler already removes cost or differential behavior changes. Do not use LUT approximation for continuously interpolated gain codes, global/identity key1 replacement, reduced precision or weaker assertions.

prohibited_followups: No source head/main update to trigger ordinary CI
